app.title: Agentic Workflow
app.subtitle: Autonomous ReAct loop executing multi-step reasoning, deterministic tool execution, stateful session memory, and mandatory Human-in-the-Loop authorization.
app.inputPlaceholder: Instruct the agent (e.g. 'Calculate (25 * 40) + 150', 'What is our refund policy?', 'Send an alert to @ops-team')...

info.description: Agentic Workflow demonstrates an autonomous agent execution loop with deterministic tool calling and a Human-in-the-Loop safety gate. Built using standard Next.js and FastAPI without heavy orchestration libraries.
info.what1: Multi-step ReAct loop (Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Final Answer) with iteration guards.
info.what2: Deterministic local tools: safe AST math calculation, knowledge base lookup, and operational alerts.
info.what3: Human-in-the-Loop authorization: pauses execution on sensitive actions until user approval.
info.canDo1: Safe Math Calculations: Evaluates arithmetic formulas, budgets, and cost projections via AST.
info.canDo2: Knowledge Base Queries: Searches internal policies (refunds, SLAs, on-call directory, cluster specs).
info.canDo3: Alerts & Notifications: Prepares operational warnings, emails, or chat broadcasts for channels/teams.
info.cannotDo1: Does NOT make phone calls or voice calls (no VoIP or telephony integration).
info.cannotDo2: Does NOT access arbitrary external APIs or open web beyond registered local tools.
info.cannotDo3: Does NOT execute critical alerts without consent: mandatory Human-in-the-Loop approval gate.
info.cannotDo4: Does NOT execute terminal commands or shell scripts.
info.step1: Select one of the suggested tasks or type a custom instruction.
info.step2: Observe the step-by-step reasoning and tool call trace in the execution timeline.
info.step3: If an alert is triggered, click Authorize or Reject to control agent execution.
